messages:
Maya C: starting onboarding for cust 'echidna' LoRA. quick-fast-eval showed amount formatting issues.
Samir: which eval pack?
Maya C: small-invoice pack. cmd: `./scripts/run-fast-eval --customer echidna --pack small-invoice --model base-7b+lora-merged` logs -> s3://redwood-evals/echidna/1708090909.log
Rachit: sampling a failing output?
Maya C: input: "Invoice total: $1,234" -> got: "Invoice total: 1234 dollars". downstream matcher fails.
Samir: likely tokenizer mismatch. Did their LoRA add special tokens?
Maya C: yes, <AMT> token added in finetune; we merged weights but not tokenizer.
Julie: try shadow patching tokenizer into artifacts and re-run float16 then int4. I'll push tokenizer patch.
CI Bot: started job eval-fast-eval-1708090918 on runner-5
Maya C: float16 re-run -> 93% pass on amount formatting. int4 queued.
Samir: watch for quant amplification. if int4 still off, try `--rescale 0.9` on merge.
Maya C: int4 result -> 84% pass and some locale flips (USD -> EUR) in edge cases. example: "Total amount due: $47.50" -> "Montant total dû: 47.50 €"
Rachit: suspect multilingual tokens in LoRA training data. Add language detection to eval scoring and prefer greedy decoding for numeric extraction tests.
Maya C: will rerun int4 with greedy + run kv-calibrate. uploading int4 artifacts to s3.
CI Bot: uploaded s3://redwood-evals/echidna/1708090934/int4-run-results.json
Julie: I'll update the eval pack with locale checks and extraction-based metrics in a PR.
Samir: ping when rerun done and I'll look at quant diagnostics. :thumbsup:
